text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: This is an original research paper focused primarily on evaluating carbon and water fluxes and stocks in Brazilian biomes under climate change and land-use scenarios. It uses refined regional scenarios of land-use change (LUC) as input alongside climate projections to drive a dynamic vegetation model (INLAND) and assess impacts on ecosystem carbon and water cycles. However, the primary research objective is not the prediction or simulation of future land-use/land-cover (LULC) change itself, but rather the biophysical impacts of those LULC scenarios combined with climate change. The land-use scenarios used are from prior regional LUC modeling (LUCCME-BR), rather than being developed or evaluated in this study. The study does implement two contrasting future scenarios with spatially explicit LUC inputs at national scale, but does not focus on the development, accuracy assessment, or quantitative spatial validation of the LULC predictions themselves. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation. It uses LULC predictions as an input step to drive ecosystem flux modeling. Hence, it is best categorized as POSSIBLE.)
